assertions.assertion: The appeal is for a PR-204 denial
The denial is because the service is not covered under the member's benefit plan
The patient has a history of recurrent palpitations
The patient has episodes of syncope coded as R55
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation coded as I48.0
The patient has supraventricular tachycardia coded as I47.1
The arrhythmias are potential etiologies for the intermittent symptoms
The cardiac event monitor was ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management
